الکترولیت هیبریدی اتیل پروپیونات و PFPN با تضعیف حل‌پوشی، باتری‌های یون سدیم را در دمای ۵۰− تا ۱۰۰ درجه و شارژ سریع پایدار می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a hybrid ethyl propionate/PFPN solvent system with weak coordination that boosts anion participation, lowers desolvation barriers, and forms inorganic-rich interphases. Its significance: enabling fast-charging, wide-temperature (−50 to 100 °C) sodium-ion full cells, including ampere-hour pouch cells with 86.3% retention after 300 cycles and stable operation at −20 and 80 °C, offering a practical electrolyte design pathway.

item.title: A Crystalline LaCl3 Reinforced Amorphous Oxyhalide Electrolyte for Thermally Stable All-Solid-State Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت کامپوزیتی Li–La–Al–O–Cl با نانوکریستال‌های LaCl3 در ماتریس آمورف، رسانایی بالای ۱ mS cm⁻¹ و پایداری گرمایی تا ۱۵۰ درجه را برای باتری تمام‌جامد فراهم می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in embedding LaCl3 nanocrystals within an amorphous Li–Al–O–Cl matrix, creating a composite electrolyte that combines high ionic conductivity (>1 mS cm–1) with exceptional thermal stability (solid at 150 °C, where baseline LAOC melts). This enables stable ASSB operation at 80 °C, unlike LAOC cells. The strategy of reinforcing a soft amorphous matrix with a rigid crystalline phase offers a cost-effective pathway for thermally robust, high-performance solid-state electrolytes.
🏷 solid electrolyte · oxyhalide electrolyte · LaCl3 nanocrystals · all-solid-state battery · thermal stability

item.title: Hybridization State Engineering of Coal Pitch-Based Carbon Materials Enabling Ultrastable Aqueous Zinc–Iodine Batteries with 150,000 Cycles
item.description:
مهندسی نسبت C(sp2)/C(sp3) در کربن مشتق از قطران زغال‌سنگ، باتری آبی روی-ید با پایداری چرخه‌ای ۱۵۰٬۰۰۰ چرخه و خودتخلیلی کم را ممکن می‌سازد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing the overlooked role of carbon hybridization state (C(sp2)/C(sp3) ratio) in tuning intrinsic activity for iodine conversion, rather than pore or doping engineering. This lowers activation energy, suppresses polyiodide shuttle, and enables 150,000-cycle stability, Ah-level pouch cells, and extended commercial carbon lifespan—offering a new design principle for high-performance zinc–iodine batteries.

item.title: Engineering Ultrathin, Tough Polymer Networks for Stable Lithium Metal Anode Interphases
item.description:
پوشش نانومتری پلیمری pDMAEMA با piCVD اینترفاز LiF-rich و پایدار ایجاد کرده و آند لیتیوم فلزی را برای باتری‌های پرانرژی بهبود می‌دهد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using photo-initiated chemical vapor deposition to create ultrathin, tough pDMAEMA nanolayers with tunable crosslinking on Li metal. This optimized network balances toughness and viscoelasticity, promotes LiF-rich interphases, and enables uniform Li deposition. Significance: 100 nm coatings achieve 338 Wh kg–1 pouch cells with 80% retention after 90 cycles, offering a design principle for high-energy Li metal batteries.

item.title: Anion-Dipole Tailoring and Directional Dipole Coordination Enable Ultrahigh-Energy-Density Lithium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using anion-dipole tailoring and directional dipole coordination to stabilize the LRMO cathode-electrolyte interface, suppressing Mn dissolution and anion hydrolysis-driven acid generation. This enables ultrahigh-energy-density lithium-ion batteries with improved high-voltage and high-temperature performance, addressing a key failure mechanism and offering a promising electrolyte design strategy for durable high-energy cathodes.

item.title: Thiourea-Based Porous Organic Polymer/Carbon Nanotubes Interlayer for the Entrapment of Lithium Polysulfides in Lithium-Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله یک لایه میانی از پلیمر آلی متخلخل تیواوره/نانولوله کربنی برای به دام انداختن پلی‌سولفیدهای لیتیوم در باتری‌های لیتیوم-گوگرد معرفی می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining a thiourea-based porous organic polymer with carbon nanotubes as an interlayer, exploiting thiourea groups to chemically entrap lithium polysulfides. This addresses the shuttle effect, a key barrier to Li-S commercialization. The significance is enhanced sulfur utilization and cycling stability, offering a low-cost, earth-abundant route toward practical high-energy Li-S batteries.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · thiourea porous organic polymer · carbon nanotube interlayer · lithium polysulfide · shuttle effect
